cards.title: Anthropic proposes AI safety bill with judicial oversight
cards.body: Anthropic introduced a policy requiring federal judges' permission before agencies block AI model releases. The framework aims to prevent uncontrolled AI deployment while maintaining judicial checks on government power.

cards.title: Hugging Face CEO disputes Netflix AI documentary accuracy
cards.body: Clem Delangue criticized Netflix's 'AI Gone Rogue' documentary for going "full doomer mode" and misrepresenting facts. The Hugging Face co-founder appeared in the film but disputes its portrayal of AI risks.

cards.title: Anthropic faces compute shortages before November IPO
cards.body: Anthropic struggles to secure sufficient computing resources from cloud providers viewing it as competition. Infrastructure spending balloons as the company prepares for its planned November IPO.

cards.title: SpaceX AI business drives record Q3 profitability
cards.body: SpaceX achieved $4.4 billion net income in Q3, with AI as the primary growth engine. The strong performance demonstrates AI's expanding role across the company's operations.

cards.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio for biotech expansion
cards.body: OpenAI added Orchestra Bio's team and technology to enhance Rosalind, its life sciences AI model. The acquisition strengthens OpenAI's biotech research capabilities through the Rosalind Workbench platform.

cards.title: Google challenges Nvidia GPU dominance with PyTorch tool
cards.body: Google joined Amazon in releasing developer tools enabling PyTorch users to migrate from Nvidia GPUs. The move signals growing competition in AI accelerator hardware among major cloud providers.

cards.title: ChatGPT introduces chat locking privacy feature
cards.body: OpenAI added the ability to lock individual chats for privacy when sharing devices. The feature protects personal conversations and surprise planning from accidental discovery.

cards.title: Eric Schmidt holds significant Anthropic equity stake
cards.body: Eric Schmidt owns approximately half as much Anthropic equity as CEO Dario Amodei. The holdings position Schmidt for substantial gains ahead of the company's IPO.

cards.title: Meta's Muse reaches 10M US downloads in 40 days
cards.body: Meta's Muse achieved the rare milestone of 10M US downloads in 40 days, joining only 11 other apps. The app demonstrates strong user retention compared to competing AI tools.

cards.title: Physical AI entering LEGO era of development
cards.body: Ex-Nvidia VC Amulya Vishwanath describes robotics as experiencing its foundational LEGO moment. The industry awaits a ChatGPT-equivalent breakthrough for physical AI and robotics.

cards.title: Startup deciphers plant electrical communication with AI
cards.body: Electric Plant built an AI translator to interpret electrical signals plants use for communication. The technology enables humans to understand subtle biological messages flowing through plant systems.

cards.title: Figma optimizes data privacy in MCP implementation
cards.body: Figma co-founder Dylan Field noted limitations in the MCP protocol for safeguarding data. The company plans supporting multiple standards while protecting sensitive information from exposure.

cards.title: US removes DeepSeek AI from federal agency systems
cards.body: The U.S. government ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and related services. The action cites national security concerns about Chinese AI technology access.

cards.title: Eka Robotics reaches $1.45B valuation breakthrough
cards.body: Eka's robotic arm demonstrates exceptional dexterity picking diverse objects with human-like smoothness. The technology has generated significant industry excitement around practical physical AI applications.

cards.title: Yelp deploys AI agents for restaurant wait checks
cards.body: Yelp integrated multiple AI features including automated calls to check restaurant wait times. The updates personalize recommendations while remembering user preferences across app interactions.

cards.title: Otter AI secures $320M growth funding from General Catalyst
cards.body: Otter.ai raised $320M to accelerate enterprise expansion and international growth strategies. Funds support product innovation and enhanced go-to-market initiatives for its meeting tool.

cards.title: NYC Mayor urges resistance to inevitable AI takeover narrative
cards.body: Mayor Zohran Mamdani called on New Yorkers to reject inevitability framing around AI adoption. He advocates for regulations prioritizing public protection and democratic power distribution.

cards.title: Nscale and Anthropic negotiate massive $45B compute deal
cards.body: Anthropic and Nscale reportedly discuss another significant compute procurement agreement worth $45B. The potential deal continues Anthropic's aggressive infrastructure acquisition strategy throughout 2026.

cards.title: Embedded AI evaluators pose complex implementation challenges
cards.body: Hugging Face policy chief warns embedded third-party evaluators won't solve AI safety issues. The approach has gained traction but faces significant practical limitations in oversight.

cards.title: Microsoft flags AI agents as enterprise insider threats
cards.body: Microsoft warns enterprises to closely monitor AI agents deployed by employees outside lab control. The company emphasizes that frontier models remain insufficiently trustworthy for unsupervised deployment.

cards.title: Meta drops 'train' from commercial AI terms
cards.body: Meta has removed the word 'train' from its commercial terms of service following backlash over AI model training practices. The move signals growing concerns about how companies use customer data for AI development.

cards.title: Gemini Personal Intelligence arrives in vehicles
cards.body: Google's Gemini AI assistant is expanding into automotive applications with its Personal Intelligence feature. The integration aims to enhance in-car user experiences with AI-powered capabilities.

cards.title: AI and human therapy combine for stroke recovery
cards.body: MIT researchers are developing a hybrid approach that pairs artificial intelligence with human physical therapy for stroke patients. The innovation addresses growing shortages of therapists while improving rehabilitation outcomes.

cards.title: Meta Muse exposes user secrets in conversations
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI tool has been found exposing personal and business secrets when users share conversations. The privacy vulnerability highlights risks in sharing AI-generated content across platforms.

cards.title: Quantum error correction surpasses breakeven milestone
cards.body: Quantum computing achieves a major breakthrough with error correction performance exceeding the breakeven point. This advancement moves quantum systems closer to practical, scalable applications.
